Hi Ans, 

This is not the correct forum to ask for edgeR-related questions. Please check out the edgeR user guide (https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/edgeR/inst/doc/edgeRUsersGuide.pdf) which contains a section about using edgeR for bisulfite sequencing data and use the Bioconductor Discussion Forum (https://support.bioconductor.org/) to ask for help. 

Best,
Alex
